lines.text: Use a short sequence to choose one task, reduce the first move, try it with support if needed, and leave a useful place to restart.

body.text: Name an acceptable stopping point, such as locating the claim reference rather than resolving the claim.

head.text: Find the first action you could see happen.

body.text: Reduce it again if it contains several decisions.
Adjust the setting or ask for company if helpful.

art.why: the slide names nothing drawable; the carousel's topic (the moment and its guide name "start")

head.text: Record what happened, where the materials are and the next step.

eyebrow.text: If the first move still will not happen

items.text: Replace 'find the paperwork' with 'open the drawer where it might be', then reassess.
Remove one obstacle, such as a missing charger or a screen crowded with unrelated tabs.
Ask for specific company: someone present while you open a message, not someone to supervise you.
Request an accessible alternative if the format is the barrier.
Record what prevented the start so tomorrow's attempt can use a different setup.

line.text: A walked-through version of the hard thing, one step on screen at a time, so starting is not a decision you have to make alone.
